text.en: Horace Danby is a respectable man who steals once a year. This year he is in for a surprise.

Horace Danby is about fifty, unmarried, a lock maker, and looks respectable. He is good but not completely honest.
He loves to collect rare books, and once a year he steals to buy them.
This year he plans to rob a wealthy house to get money for a special book.
He opens the safe hidden behind a painting. His hay fever makes him sneeze with flowers around.
A young woman appears and surprises him. She says her jewels are in the safe and she has forgotten the combination.
Horace is pleased to help, believing she is the lady of the house. He opens the safe and gives her the jewels.
Two days later the police arrest Horace. The woman had been a thief who stole the jewels, leaving his fingerprints behind.
The story shows that even a careful planner can be fooled. Trust can be a trap.

problem.en: Horace steals once a year for 15 years. How many robberies?

why.en: The text says fifteen years ago he began.

requiredIdeas.en: He did not check her story

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking Horace was a hardened criminal

points.en: Horace Danby collects rare books and steals once a year.
He is tricked by a young woman.
The story shows trust and deceit.
